image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - First Quarter, Fiscal 2025
summary: This document presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended June 30, 2024, and June 30, 2023, along with quarter-over-quarter comparisons for March 31, 2024. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with year-over-year growth percentages provided. Notably, revenues increased from 4,617 million to 4,714 million, reflecting a 2.1% growth, while net profit before minority interest rose to 764 million, marking a 5.6% increase. The operating margin remained stable at around 21%, indicating consistent operational efficiency. The document also highlights significant changes in expenses and earnings per share, providing a comprehensive overview of the company's financial performance during this period.
